concerns.text:
The `processed_target_vector` schema lists the allowed `cell_line` enum values as
`["GM12878", "K562", "HMEMC", "IMR90", "HepG2"]`. The typo `HMEMC` does not match the
actual cell line name `HMEC` used throughout the plan and research documents.
This mismatch will cause schema validation failures for the processed target
files, breaking the data‑hygiene and reproducibility guarantees required by
Constitution III. Correct the enum entry to `"HMEC"` to align with the real dataset.
